name: PKCS#7 Extractor
description: Pull every certificate out of a PKCS#7 certificate bag.

examples.label: Extract certificates from the test bag

hints.certsOnly: Only **certificate bags** are supported: signed or encrypted containers are rejected rather than yielding an empty result.
hints.binary: The bag is binary; paste it as base64, hex or PEM.

faq.q: In what order are the certificates returned?
faq.a: In container order; use the chain parser when you need an ordered chain.

faq.q: Can it extract a private key?
faq.a: No. A P7B holds certificates only; use the PKCS#12 parser for containers with keys.

faq.q: Why does a signed container fail?
faq.a: This version implements certificate bags only; signed containers are an upstream gap.
